modules.title: Your first Swedish conversation
modules.outcome: Introduce yourself, talk about daily life and dreams, and build clear sentences with common verbs, nouns and describing words.
modules.description: Start conversations, ask questions, use present-time verbs, talk about work and free time, and connect ideas about your dreams.

vocabularyTargets.active: Introductions, feelings, people, common help verbs, work, free time, interests and dreams.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: Swedish sounds; present, command and infinitive verb forms; en/ett words; definite nouns; adjective agreement.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Introduce yourself; ask and answer simple questions; explain what you can, must and want to do; describe work, habits and a dream.
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Greetings, personal details, pronouns and question words return in conversations about daily life.

story.title: The first class
story.setting: A community class and a first Swedish conversation
story.summary: Alex meets Elin and learns to share a name, home, origin, and languages before noticing the sounds inside those useful phrases. At the next class break they talk about how they feel and the people in their lives. Maja joins them to talk about her dreams.

modules.title: The past and many things
modules.outcome: Tell what happened, describe a past day, and talk about more than one person or thing.
modules.description: Use common past-tense verbs, react to news, build Swedish plurals and write a short message about your week.

vocabularyTargets.active: Past-time phrases, reactions to news, everyday actions, things at home and friendship.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: Regular and irregular past forms, five noun plural groups and informal-letter structure.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Tell yesterday's story in order, count and describe things, and write to a friend.
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Verb-second word order, common present verbs and linking words support longer past stories.

story.title: News and memories
story.setting: Conversations about yesterday, belongings and friendship
story.summary: Maja shares news about a test. Alex and Elin count things for a gathering and tell each other about their week.

modules.title: Everyday life
modules.outcome: Handle common conversations about health, shopping, family, time and weather.
modules.description: Practise useful language for a doctor, clothes and food, then arrange everyday plans with numbers, times and weather.

vocabularyTargets.active: Symptoms, clothes, food, quantities, family, clock times and weather.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: Plural and definite adjective forms, prices, larger numbers and ordinal numbers.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Explain symptoms, shop for essentials, present family members and arrange a picnic.
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Plural nouns, past actions, questions and personal information return in practical situations.

story.title: Everyday plans
story.setting: Health, shopping and a picnic with friends
story.summary: Alex and Elin talk about feeling ill, clothes and shopping, then plan food, family visits and a picnic around the weather.

modules.title: Plans, rules and complaints
modules.outcome: Invite someone, compare choices, give advice, complain politely and explain a route.
modules.description: Use object words, dates and comparisons, then practise rules, advice, formal complaints and directions.

vocabularyTargets.active: Invitations, dates, comparisons, weekdays, advice, permission, complaints and directions.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: Definite plural nouns, object pronouns, comparative forms and formal-letter structure.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Agree a meeting, compare options, help a friend, write a complaint and give directions.
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Time, people, modal verbs and command forms return in longer social and formal tasks.

story.title: Making arrangements
story.setting: Invitations, choices, advice and practical problems
story.summary: Maja makes plans with Alex and Elin. The friends compare films, discuss rules and solve a problem with a purchase; Henrik helps them give clear directions.

modules.title: Mine, yours and the future
modules.outcome: Explain ownership clearly and talk about plans, predictions and opinions.
modules.description: Choose possessive and reflexive forms, then distinguish intentions, predictions and personal opinions.

vocabularyTargets.active: Home and personal belongings, possessives, next-year plans, predictions and opinions.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: Reflexive forms, sin/sitt/sina and four common ways to speak about the future.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Say whose things they are, describe a home, state plans and make a prediction with a reason.
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Family, home, adjective agreement and help verbs support more precise personal messages.

story.title: Belongings and plans
story.setting: Everyday conversations about ownership and next year
story.summary: Alex, Elin and Maja work out whose things they have, then share plans, predictions and opinions about the coming year.

modules.title: Experience, school, work and home
modules.outcome: Discuss experiences and everyday issues, support an opinion, and describe the home and life you want.
modules.description: Move from life experience and school memories to work-life balance, housing, the environment and a first structured argument.

vocabularyTargets.active: Experience, personality, school, work, restaurants, housing, environment and opinion phrases.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: Present perfect, main and subordinate clauses, cause and consequence, and argumentative-text structure.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Tell what you have done, discuss school and work, manage a restaurant visit, seek a home and argue for a view.
vocabularyTargets.recycled: Past and future forms, comparisons, formal messages and linking words return in sustained speaking and writing.

story.title: The life you want
story.setting: School, work, a restaurant and the search for a home
story.summary: Alex and Maja compare experiences and school memories. With Elin and Henrik they explore work, restaurant requests, housing and environmental choices, then explain their own views.

titles: Introduce yourself and hear Swedish sounds
How are you? People and questions
What you do, what you can, what you don't
Better, best, and the days of the week

Next year, and what you think
My ideal home, and my opinion
